title: Beautiful Subsets

monster.name: Concordance Sylph
monster.title: Purifier of Forbidden Differences
monster.defeatQuote: No two items in a beautiful subset may differ by exactly k!

description: You are given an array `nums` of positive integers and a positive integer `k`. A subset of `nums` is beautiful if it does not contain two integers with an absolute difference of `k`. Return the number of non-empty beautiful subsets of the array `nums`.
starterCode:
def beautifulSubsets(nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
    pass
solutionCode:
def beautifulSubsets(nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
    nums.sort()
    n = len(nums)
    ans = 0
    def backtrack(idx, current_set):
        nonlocal ans
        if idx == n:
            if current_set:
                ans += 1
            return
        backtrack(idx + 1, current_set)
        if nums[idx] - k not in current_set:
            current_set.add(nums[idx])
            backtrack(idx + 1, current_set)
            current_set.remove(nums[idx])
    backtrack(0, set())
    return ans
hints: Since n <= 20, sort nums and backtrack: exclude or include nums[idx] only if nums[idx] - k is not already in the active subset.
